blocks.text: X-ray crystallography 1912 mein William Henry Bragg aur William Lawrence Bragg ne banai. Is kaam par unhen 1915 ka Physics ka Nobel Prize mila. Tab se yeh bohat si cheezon ko parhne (analyze karne) ke liye istemal ho rahi hai, jaise minerals, salts (namak), metals (dhaatein), proteins, carbohydrates, nucleic acids aur vitamins. Is technique mein X-rays ka beam (shuaon ki dhaar) crystal par dala jata hai. Crystal ke atoms aur molecules X-rays ko khaas simton (directions) mein mod dete hain; ise diffraction kehte hain. Mude hue beams ke angles (zaviye) aur intensity (taqat) se crystal ke andar electron density ki 3D tasveer banti hai. Phir is electron density se molecule ki 3D structure banai jati hai.
X-ray crystallography kaise kaam karti hai, yeh samajhne ke liye protein ki structure maloom karne ki misal lete hain. Is tareeqe ke yeh qadam (steps) hain:

items: Protein crystallization: saaf (purified) protein ko thos (solid) crystal ki shakal mein badalna. Crystal is liye chahiye ke us mein protein ke molecules ek ba-qaida, baar baar dohrane wale pattern mein lage hote hain, aur isi se X-ray mein saaf tasveer milti hai. Crystal banane ke liye scientists protein ko aahista aahista khaas solutions (mahlool) mein milate hain jin se molecules tarteeb se ek doosre se chipak jate hain. Is mein ghante, din ya hafte bhi lag sakte hain, aur temperature, pH aur namak ki concentration (miqdar) ko dhyan se control karna padta hai. Jab saaf aur mazboot (stable) crystal ban jaye to agle qadam mein istemal hota hai.

Diffraction pattern banana: achha crystal ban jaye to use X-ray machine par lagaya jata hai. X-rays ka beam crystal par mukhtalif angles se dala jata hai. Crystal ke atoms X-rays ko mod dete hain aur detector par diffraction pattern (nuqton yani spots ka silsila) ban jata hai.
Density map banana: in spots ke angles aur intensity mein yeh maloomat hoti hai ke crystal mein atoms kis tarteeb mein hain. Diffraction pattern se density map banaya jata hai.
Protein ki structure maloom karna: phir computer programs is data ka hisaab (mathematical analysis) karte hain, aur yeh calculations data ko protein ki 3D structure mein badal deti hain.

blocks.alt: Baen se X-rays aa kar ek jamni crystal par parti hain; mura hua teer batata hai ke crystal ghoomta hai. Bikhri (diffracted) shuaein ek lambe X-ray detector par jati hain. Teer Computer + Graphics ke dabbe tak, phir neeche Electron Density Map (zanjeer ke gird neela jaal) tak, aur baen Protein Model tak jata hai jo helices aur strands wale ribbon se bana hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer (arrows) ke saath chalein: crystal ko ghuma kar har rukh se X-rays dali jati hain; crystal ke atoms unhen mukhtalif angles par bikher dete hain aur detector un ka pattern record karta hai. Computer is pattern se electron density map banata hai, jis mein atoms ki jagah dikhti hai, aur us map par protein ka model bithaya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Protein ko solution mein seedha X-ray beam ke saamne kyun nahi rakha jata, aur sab se pehle kya karna hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Solution mein molecules be-tarteeb hote hain, is liye X-rays dhundla sa bikhar jati hain aur saaf spots nahi bante. Sirf crystal mein molecules ek ba-qaida pattern mein hote hain aur saaf diffraction spots dete hain. Is liye pehla qadam saaf protein ka crystal banana hai, jis mein temperature, pH aur namak ko control kar ke ghanton se hafton tak lag sakte hain.

items: X-ray crystallography: Bragg (baap aur beta) ne 1912 mein banai, 1915 ka Physics Nobel Prize mila; minerals, salts, metals, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleic acids aur vitamins ki structure maloom karti hai.
Qadam: protein crystallization; diffraction pattern; density map; computer se 3D structure.
